column1: # mapping_set_description: Mappings from ONGA DataType and FeatureType terms to EDAM data and topic terms. EDAM covers data products and analysis topics, so coverage concentrates on DataType; located sequence features map to the Sequence Ontology instead (see so.sssom.tsv).
# subject_id is the term's permanent id (onga:ONGA_NNNNNNN, the `meaning:` of
# the permissible value, ledger curation/term_ids.tsv); subject_label is the
# live label and must agree with it. Subjects are DataType / FeatureType terms
# (src/file_content.yaml) and Format values (src/format.yaml). Compound terms that the faceting program decomposed
# (see mappings/facet_decomposition.tsv) carry no mapping of their own: the
# haplotype_resolution, ...) has no EDAM counterpart, so the EDAM sense is
# carried entirely by the atomic base term's row.
